name: What is the typical cost to build a detached ADU in Orange County?
description: Costs for a detached ADU in Orange County typically range from $150,000 to over $300,000, depending on size, design, and finishes.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to build a detached ADU in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a detached ADU in Orange County varies significantly based on size, design complexity, finishes, and site-specific conditions. Smaller, simpler units might start around $150,000, while larger or custom-designed ADUs with high-end finishes can exceed $300,000. These costs typically include design, permits, materials, and labor. A detailed quote requires a site assessment and discussion of your specific project goals.
